question.problem:
The matrix $K$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(K).$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2},$ where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{k}_{1}+{x}_{2}{k}_{2},$ and ${k}_{1},$ ${k}_{2}$ are the respective columns of $K.$

$$
K=[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 5 \\ 4\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(K),$ we need to check if the equation $Kx=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[K\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[K\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 1 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-4{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & -18\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-8{x}_{2}=4 \\ {x}_{2}=5 \\ 0=-18.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get the false statement $0=-18.$ 

Therefore, the system is inconsistent, which implies that $b\notin \text{Col}(K).$
